name: Defeat Nek'rosh

intro: Defeat Nek'rosh marks the culmination of the Alliance campaign against the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. With their siege engines sabotaged, adventurers are ordered to strike down Chieftain Nek'rosh directly to secure Menethil Harbor. Bringing his severed head back to Captain Stoutfist shatters the orcish threat to the coastal port.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Stoutly done, friend. You have dealt a telling blow to the Dragonmaw orc clan. They may never recover. And the destruction of those catapults has made Menethil Harbor safe.
You are a traveler of merit, and the kingdom of Ironforge rewards those who serve it well.
